title: vue2-script-setup-transform is deprecated
summary: npm marks vue2-script-setup-transform as deprecated: "renamed to `unplugin-vue2-script-setup`, see https://github.com/antfu/unplugin-vue2-script-setup/releases/tag/v0.4.0"

constraints: Preserve the compiled `<script setup>` output and the order of Vue 2 build plugins.

steps.title: Replace the transform plugin
steps.instructions: Replace vue2-script-setup-transform with unplugin-vue2-script-setup in dependencies and the build configuration.

steps.title: Verify compiled components
steps.instructions: Compare the compiled single-file components and their runtime behavior with the previous build.

verification.purpose: Build the Vue 2 application with the maintained plugin.
Run the component and repository tests when defined.
